notes.title: 星光的引導－世界的巡禮者 商店頁面正式公開
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3102010


星光的引導－世界的巡禮者 
商店頁面正式公開，加入願望清單就是現在！

https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/fe4da34673cf2459fb6a64cf436adc4bd96e9aea.jpg


Story
一名來自小村落的少女，拿起星星的手杖，跟著伙伴踏上了旅程。 在旅程中會遇到各種冒險和挑戰，究竟會有什麼在等待著少女呢？

Character
艾莉絲：來自一個小村落的少女，對於這個世界充滿好奇心而踏上旅程

莫爾摩：為了觀察人間界而從魔界過來的「幽靈」少女

斯碧涅爾：代表充實、好奇心、突出為印象的寶石，擁有尖晶石之力的少女

凱洛拉伊：習慣一個人孤獨的少女，遵從自己的野望流浪於世界各處

遊戲中還有更多的角色等著玩家去發掘...


Feature
■ 傳統的回合制RPG遊戲，過程中會有許多角色加入隊伍

■ 豐富的技能與各種敵人，讓玩家可以思考打法與策略

■ 許多可愛的角色，可以跟她們互動

notes.title: [RMAsia] “The Land of Rest 1” Demo is now available!
notes.content:
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/c378561246253166a081a7a88d391896e6e00f2e.png
[code]
關注RMAsia鑑賞家
[/code]

STORY
《The Lands of Rest1》 : Part 1 is a story-driven game that narrates the life of Bipara in the Underground Realm.

"In the days of the past, I had a complete family and lived a simple, happy life. However, one day, I lost everything."
A sudden accident took away Bipara’s parents and home. The only thing left behind by his father—the family heirloom, a crystal from the legendary Underground Realm—became his only support.
Guided by this crystal, Bipara arrives in the Underground Realm.

Why did this crystal guide him here in the first place?
The mystery of the story will slowly unfold as the plot progresses —


DEMO
The demo version allows you to play through chapters U0 to U2, with a playtime of approximately 2 hours.

The full version of the game will eventually have 6 chapters (U0 to U5). Below is an estimate of the length for each chapter and the range covered in the demo.
https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/41570851/599246b6c5209708ae57212ae4c6a07f0358c301.jpg

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461310/1_Demo/

If you’re interested in the game, please consider adding it to your wishlist. The full version is scheduled for release in Q4 2025 (by the end of the year).

A new Peacemaker game, Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor, will be available in 2024!

[Introduction]
A dark fantasy JRPG. The imperial princess Chrysoberyl must fight the Bloody Emperor who has usurped the throne. However, her army is small and her allies are conniving. It is a bloody war where she will have to choose between PEACE and LIVES...

Be sure to add this game to your wishlist and keep an eye out for updates.

notes.content:
1. The balance of combat 1 was adjusted.
2. The bug on the overworld was fixed.

notes.title: The sequels, Glorious Princess & Bloody Emperor, will have support for English.
notes.content:
We would like to clarify that the sequels to this game, Hero King Quest: Peacemaker Prologue, are the following games.
1. Peacemaker: Glorious Princess
2. Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor
Hero King Quest has had support for English. And the other two will do the same.

Furthermore, we have an old game, Dark Lord: Peacemaker. It is not a sequel to Hero King Quest and WON'T be translated into English.
On the contrary, the Peacemaker Series, which is composed of the above three games, is the reboot of Dark Lord: Peacemaker.
Therefore, even if you have not played Dark Lord: Peacemaker, it WON'T affect you to understand the stories of the above three games.

Lastly, thank you for your interest in this series. Please look forward to the release of Peacemaker: Glorious Princess and Peacemaker: Bloody Emperor.
